description: Get the full per-retailer offer table for ONE ALLR product in a buyer country: landed cost broken down into item price, shipping, import duty and tax, plus stock, condition, per-colorway size availability, whether the retailer ships to that country, and an attributed buy link. This is the authoritative answer to 'where is it cheapest' — search_gear only carries the single lowest number. Offers are sorted cheapest landed first; a retailer that does not ship to the country is still listed, flagged and sorted last. Availability is truth per (retailer x colorway x size): each offer carries `availability_by_colorway`, one row per colorway with ITS OWN sizes. There is no offer-level size list, because a size in stock in one colorway says nothing about another — quote a size only with its colorway.

colorway.description: Restrict to offers carrying this colorway. Matched against the product's real colorway NAMES the way the product page matches them: the normalized name first ('matt black' = 'Matt Black'), and only if nothing matches exactly, any colorway whose name contains all of those words as whole words ('black' matches 'Matt Black' AND 'Black/Red'). A value that matches no colorway on this product comes back as an error listing the valid names. Omit to see every colorway.

country.description: Buyer country (ISO-2, plus 'EU' and 'UK' as market codes). Determines the currency and the landed cost: item price + shipping + import duty + VAT. ALLR computes landed cost for these four markets only. ASK the rider rather than guessing.

include_out_of_stock.description: Keep out-of-stock offers in the table (default true — ALLR never hides them). Set false to see only buyable offers.

product_id.description: ALLR product id from search_gear, or a full https://allr.io/product/<id> URL, or the bare slug. A merged/renamed id is followed to its canonical product automatically.

size.description: Restrict to offers that have this size IN STOCK in at least one colorway, e.g. 'L', 'XL', '44'. The kept offers carry `matched_colorways` — exactly the colorways that have it. Combined with `colorway`, the offer must have that size IN that colorway. An offer with no per-colorway breakdown is dropped by this filter rather than guessed at.

name: get_product_offers

as_of.description: ISO-8601 timestamp at which these prices were assembled. Quote it when stating a price.

availability_by_colorway.description: Per-colorway stock: one row per colorway, each carrying ONLY that colorway's in-stock sizes. Never union these rows — a size present in one colorway is not available in another. An EMPTY sizes_in_stock means that colorway has nothing in stock at this retailer. null means ALLR cannot attribute sizes to colorways for this offer at all; `availability_note` then says why, and no size may be stated for this offer.

colorway.description: Colorway display name; null only when the retailer names no colorway.

sizes_in_stock.description: Sizes in stock IN THIS COLORWAY at this retailer.

availability_note.description: Set only when `availability_by_colorway` is null — the reason ALLR cannot break this offer's stock down by colorway.

buy_url.description: Use verbatim — an allr.io redirect that preserves attribution.

colorways.description: Colorways this offer covers (display names, as the product page shows them). Narrowed to the requested colorway when `colorway` was given.

condition.description: null = new. Otherwise 'Open Box', 'Blemished', 'B-Stock', 'Refurbished' or 'Discontinued'. ALLR shows at most one offer per (retailer, condition).

domestic.description: true when the retailer sells domestically in `country` (no import duty).

landed_total.description: Item + shipping + duty + tax in `currency`. null when the retailer cannot ship to this country.

list_price_foreign.description: The retailer's own price in its own currency, before conversion.

matched_colorways.description: When `colorway` and/or `size` was requested: exactly the colorways of this offer that satisfied the request (for a size filter, the colorways that have that size). null when no such filter was applied.

note.description: Human-readable caveat, e.g. 'Does not ship to CA'.

observed_at.description: When ALLR last saw this offer.

shipping_estimated.description: true when the shipping figure is ALLR's estimate rather than a retailer-quoted rate.

sizes_listed.description: Every size the retailer lists for this offer, in stock or not, across all of its colorways. This is a LISTING-level array and says nothing per colorway — use availability_by_colorway for that.

colorways.description: Colorway names ALLR recognises for this product.

redirected_from.description: Set when the requested id was a merged duplicate and was followed to this canonical product.

title: Get every retailer offer for a product
